scope: Retained s2c 0x0132 named definitions, their conditional native record producer and descriptor constructor. Wire receipt does not establish the later selected runtime descriptor.
method: Retained Ghidra instruction rows were authenticated against the identified PE through raw-backed section mappings. Contiguous authenticated extents and SHA-256 values are listed below. PE section metadata establishes zero-filled virtual storage separately from raw file bytes. Addresses are VAs; subtract imageBase for RVAs. No runtime client state was observed.

incoming.offsetBasis: application payload after the 16-byte game-message prefix

fields.name: unresolvedTail
fields.evidence: xivl-captures:studies/command-registration/derived/occurrences.csv; zero in all retained records, semantic role unproved

incoming.implementationCondition: NullActorImpl table 0x00FE02AC slot 49 = 0x0076CA90. LuaActorImpl table 0x00FDFB2C slot 49 = 0x00759DE0, RET 4, which does not construct this record. Receipt alone does not select the implementation table.

anchors.fact: Reads selector byte payload+1; calls byte-copy helper 0x0078DDE0 at 0x0076CAE3.
Reads priority byte payload+0; calls 0x0075AEE0 at 0x0076CAF5.
Zero input priority is replaced with byte[0x01355296]. Nonzero input is retained; result written at 0x0075AEF2.
0x0076A3F0 reuses or creates pending owner at implementation+0x48.
Passes name, normalized priority and selector to pending-record producer 0x00767B40.
Calls 0x007836D0 on owner+0x14. Its available-capacity arm constructs at vector end and advances by 0x58; growth-path ordering is not claimed.
Calls 0x00762CA0 with initializer receiver and pending owner. Only the callsite is used here; the retained 0x006F3420 listing has a gap and no continuous whole-function extent is claimed.
Calls 0x006F1C20 with record, record+0x54 and record+0x55; walk advances by 0x58.

pendingRecords.handoff: The conditional pending-owner transfer and cleanup are retained in xivl-decomp:docs/input/chara-selection-producers.md#pending-native-command-record-input. They do not prove that the implementation receiving a particular message is the one handed off, or that the initialized player is the later execution receiver.

unequal.priority: Only name is passed to this constructor. It does not receive or store the supplied priority.

construction.installation: 0x006F1CD2 calls 0x00725ED0 on player+0xfc to append the constructed descriptor.
construction.otherProducer: Compiled receiver body 0x0089D4F0 casts the supplied ActorBase to MyPlayer (RTTI 0x012C19A4) and calls 0x006F1C20 at 0x0089D51C with name at this+4, priority at this+0x58 and selector at this+0x59. The retained direct-reference analysis establishes no wire-instantiation route for this receiver class; see symbols.json BCS-Y-0945/0946/1111. The pending-record path is a separate producer.
construction.lookup: 0x0071CA50 scans player+0xfc in order, compares descriptor+4 name through 0x00445D20 at 0x0071CA88 and returns the first equal entry at 0x0071CAAA. It does not test the selected descriptor vtable.

globals.initialization: All three addresses lie in virtual zero-fill after the raw-backed .data extent. PE loading supplies initial zero bytes. These are not bytes read from the file and do not establish their values at registration or execution time.

targetedReferenceScan.method: Searched the exact PE for each explicit four-byte absolute address encoding and inspected the returned instruction sites. This does not enumerate computed or indirect aliases.
targetedReferenceScan.result: Inspected sites read or compare the bytes. No direct writer was identified in this scan; absence of indirect mutation is not proved.

interpretation: The capture study owns counts, source identities and exact connection/frame/packet locators. It observes the eight definitions in repeated batches associated with the same client player reference, not descriptor memory.

With selector global zero, commandForced constructs CommandBlock with priority 11 and commandRequest constructs CommandNonBlock. The same conditional rules cover the other observed names. No unconditional selected-instance callback claim follows.

The commandRequest wire priority input 0 is not command-sheet priority -1. The latter selects a Lua name, whereas the former passes through default-priority normalization before a constructor that does not use it on the nonblock arm.

The Lua commandRequest eligibility bypass and the shared direct 0x012d fallback remain as recorded in player_command_wire_contract.json. Incoming 0x0132 definitions are distinct from outbound command invocation operands.

boundary.firstUnresolvedNativeInput: The selected runtime descriptor returned by 0x0071CA50 from the later player+0xfc vector: actual receiving implementation and handoff identity, runtime selector/default bytes, completed initialization, insertion order, lifetime and installed vtable are not observed.
boundary.firstUnresolvedServerBoundary: Server consumption of the opcode 0x012d record queued through 0x00DB06A0: no server decoder, admission, mutation, settlement, cancellation, timing or response contract is established.
boundary.ceiling: Retained wire definitions and conditional client construction are proved. Callback execution, eligibility success, transport delivery and server acceptance or policy are not.
